title: Cellular Respiration - Stages and Location
body:
Study the diagram of cellular respiration below:

```
[CELLULAR RESPIRATION OVERVIEW]

  GLUCOSE (C6H12O6)
        |
        v
  +-----------+
  | GLYCOLYSIS| ---> 2 Pyruvate + 2 ATP + 2 NADH
  | (Cytoplasm)|
  +-----------+
        |
        v  [enters mitochondrion]
  +-----------------+
  | KREBS CYCLE     | ---> 2 ATP + 6 NADH + 2 FADH2
  | (Matrix)        |
  +-----------------+
        |
        v
  +------------------------+
  | ELECTRON TRANSPORT     | ---> 34 ATP + H2O
  | CHAIN (Inner membrane) |
  +------------------------+
```

A student claims that glycolysis cannot occur without oxygen. Evaluate this statement and explain where most ATP is produced.
